svg.title: AfterKey architecture
svg.desc: The owner signs in a browser wallet. AfterKey submits reviewed transactions to ENSv2 and Uniswap v3 on Sepolia. Signed HTTP requests pass through a validating relay to Chainlink CRE. CRE also receives cron and approval-log triggers, verifies GitHub departure cases, and reads contracts through Multicall3. Wallet receipts and CRE execution evidence remain separate.
svg.text: Sepolia 11155111 · Owner signs asset changes · CRE verifies independently
All reads pinned to one block
